title: This is Why They Want Trump Dead... Exposure IS Now His Best Protection (VIDEO) | The Gateway Pundit | by Grant Stinchfield
text: Congresswoman “Mad Maxine” Waters said the quiet part out loud, “What do they have on us.” She claims she’s worried about privacy, but she is really more concerned about exposure. Both President Trump and Elon Musk believe the only reason for the outrageous and egregious government spending is to feed a massive money laundering scheme designed to enrich corrupt politicians and their friends. Those involved wanted President Trump dead because they knew he would expose the scheme. Now that the season of exposure has begun, it’s too late to turn back. Killing him now would do nothing now. Uncovering the widespread fraud in government may be President Trump’s best form of protection. Plus, the Transgender Maniacs show no signs of giving up. They are crawling out of the woodwork in Massachusetts to create a Transgender sanctuary city. Two De-transitioners join me to expose the dangers of the trans movement.
